name: Struve 2398 A
description: A nearby red dwarf, 36% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: radius in solar radii, 0.3561 +/- 0.0039, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: mass 0.318 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725A: effective temperature in K, 3407 +/- 15, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 36% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.3561 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,407 K.
